name: Sysop
description: The boring infrastructure monk: every machine's memory, load, disk and failed units on one page, a glyph a day, and a page in the door before the kernel kills anything.

machines.description: The machines the first tick writes on the page's [machines::…] line (default: this host alone); edit the page after

self.description: This host's own name in that list, sampled without ssh (default: the host's machine-name, else its hostname)

outline.description: Another outline on this host to keep the page in (default the one it runs for)

actions.label: Look at every machine
actions.description: Samples every machine on the sysop page's [machines::…] line, writes the numbers on the page and the day's health note, and opens a trip note when a threshold is crossed

actions.label: Calm a machine
actions.description: Runs the one command the open trip recorded for the machine (a user unit or container restart, never a kill), then looks again and writes what happened on the trip note

args.name: machine
args.label: Machine
args.description: the machine with an open trip, as the page names it
